17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1454 West Victoria Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,170 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicants are seeking a zoning change to permit construction of a
second-story sunroom addition that will replace the existing rooftop deck
located above the attached garage. The proposed addition will contain 239
square feet of total floor area and will measure 19 feet-8.25 inches in height.
The existing single-family home will continue to be supported by the
parking space located within the attached garage. Pursuant to Secs. 17-13-
0303-D and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the
Applicants are seeking all additional relief to permit the attached Type 1
Plan Set, including the reduction of the west side setback, reduction of the
combined side setback total, reduction of the rear setback, and reduction of
the rear yard open space total because of the subject lot’s triangular shape
and the footprint of the existing single family home on the subject lot.

(A) — The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,460 square feet (1.13 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 2,170 square feet per D.U.
(1 residential unit)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 1 parking space (existing)

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0.48 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 2.93 feet
East Side: 0 (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 0 (existing)

*Pursuant to Secs. 17-13-0303-D and 17-13-1101-B, the Applicants are seeking all
additional relief to permit the attached Type 1 Plan Set, including to reduce the west side
setback, the combined side setback total, the rear setback, and the rear yard open space
total because of the subject lot’s triangular shape and the footprint of the existing single
family home on the subject lot.

(E) Building Height:
a. Existing single-family home: 35.42 feet
b. Proposed sunroom addition: 19 feet-8.25 inches
